says: Main's pnpm lint is red: oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts lists scripts/typecheck.sh on NOT_YET_PORTED, and main no longer tracks that file, so the tracked-scripts part fails every lint run, on main and on every pull request that merges it.
proof: At main 4909b55d, git ls-tree origin/main scripts/typecheck.sh prints nothing, while git show origin/main:oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts has "scripts/typecheck.sh" at line 35. PR 1506 (65edf5c2) deleted the script and PR 1517 (c96e35d0) added the list; the two merged across each other. node oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts exits 1 with: scripts/typecheck.sh is on NOT_YET_PORTED, and git does not track it.
cost: Every pull request that merges main gets a red lint part, so ci-required cannot go green until the line goes; PR 1504 deletes it so its own run can pass.
